entities.name: Charles Darwin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: English naturalist (1809–1882) who formulated the theory of evolution by natural selection, published in On the Origin of Species (1859). His theory unified the life sciences and profoundly changed humanity's understanding of its place in nature.
